crossRefs.note: He said to Abram, “I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”
You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, gave him the name of Abraham,
He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia…

people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

people.name: Haran
people.line: Son of Terah, brother of Abraham and father of Lot.

people.name: Terah
people.line: Abraham's father who settled in Haran

people.name: Ur
people.line: The hometown of Abraham in Mesopotamia

translations.web: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.
translations.bsb: During his father Terah’s lifetime, Haran died in his native land, in Ur of the Chaldeans.
translations.kjv: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
translations.asv: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
